message: In the twin under-deck Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, mass on spring with damper tuned to bridge mode) retrofit concept, the crowd comfort acceptance has Comfort Level (CL, Setra comfort grade) target question raised by Manager, thank you Manager. To check it I used the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (E6)) against the Den Hartog optimum result (the Den Hartog optimum result (E3)). I found reduction from 17.50 metres per second squared to 0.74 metres per second squared with 9.44 percent effective damping, according to Setra, 2006. I propose accepting Comfort Level 2 as comfortable outcome for this lively 40 metre bridge. My position: ready because damping increase and acceleration reduction are demonstrated. In the concealed mounting concept, the install and maintenance method has closure and visibility risk, thank you Retrofit Integration Architect. To check it I used the concealed mounting detail (the concealed mounting detail (E9)) with the slip safety result (the slip factor calculation (E15)). I found zero hardware above deck level with 14.7 dimensionless slip margin installable from below soffit with no deck closure, according to Coulomb, 1785. I propose night-time clamp-beam install with six-monthly inspection and annual re-tuning. My position: ready because invisible-from-deck and maintainable build is shown.
